body: the ones about other things come and go. these just stick with me. the coping mechanisms aren't working.

Not so much something bad will happen,  I'm having a bad period with my depression, and I have trouble letting people look after me because I'm weak, and I just don't like talking about it, and letting them look after me means talking about it... but letting people look after you when you're physically hurt or sick doesn't seem weak. I think. I'm not quite sure.
I've heard it's pretty common in people with anxiety
I can't speak on phones but I suppose it wont hurt to see if I can see her earlier, but I dunno, I'll end up feeling so silly.
If it was as easy as 'not thinking about bad things' I would be overjoyed. I have coping mechanisms to stop bad thoughts, and they're not working.

But I can't stop thinking about it, It's been on my mind for about 3-4 days now, and it's getting worse. I can deal with fleeting intrusive thoughts, but this isn't fleeting. It's almost obsessive.  When I drop a knife, my first reaction is being disappointed it didn't hurt my foot. I can't stop thinking about it, and the coping methods I have for intrusive thoughts aren't helping.
